inputs.label: The Wind Waker GameCube disc image (GZLP01 or GZLE01)
inputs.help: Your own uncompressed .iso of The Wind Waker: European (GZLP01, revision 0) or USA (GZLE01). Compressed formats such as .rvz or .ciso do not work.

steps.text: If WakerQuest is already installed, do not uninstall it. Uninstalling erases your saves and memory card data. qgp installs over it.
Open WakerQuest from Library > Unknown Sources. On the first start, select your ISO in the file picker.

notes: Never uninstall before an update: saves and memory card data are lost. install-apk uses -r, which keeps them. No disc header check: two game IDs (GZLP01 rev 0, GZLE01) are accepted and the schema takes one. The payload also lists /sdcard/Android/data/io.github.wakerquest/files/ as another folder.
